messages:
jamie_sourcing: Heads up — vendor updated on the H100 replacement batch. Frank says 58 units outbound next Tue but customs flagged 12 units due to serial mismatch. Need RMA split + depot rework plan. @alice_ops can you confirm dock capacity for Wed/Thu next week?
frank_vendor: Sorry for the hassle. We pulled the manifest and 12 SKUs show serials that don't match the PO. We're proposing: air-express 12 flagged units (AWB 123-4567890) + sea for the rest, split AWB and split invoice. We'll create separate RMA numbers so depot can intake separately. Can expedite labels today.
alice_ops: I can open two dock windows but need exact ETA window. Wed morning is tight, Thu afternoon more open. How long for customs clearance on the air leg?
maria_pm: tagging cost impact — if we move 12 to air, rough delta vs sea? Need numbers for execs. Also any SLA impact for affected customers?
frank_vendor: Air delta ~+$2,100 per unit (incl. duty insurance). Sea ETA for bulk ~10-12 days. Air can clear in 24-48h on arrival if docs correct. We can absorb half the expedite fee if Redwood covers carrier premium and local customs brokerage.
ops-bot: Shipment update: AWB 123-4567890 (12 items) status=booked, est-arrival=2025-07-17 05:30Z. MAWB for ocean bulk: MAWB 987-6543210, container ETA=2025-07-22.
alice_ops: Wed morning not workable with current docs; Thu 14:00-18:00 slot available. We need RMA labels preprinted and a manifest in CSV. Can you push labels to S3 or send to depot email? Also confirm whether serial rework includes reflash or only sticker replacement.
frank_vendor: We'll send labels to the depot email + s3. Rework scope: sticker replacement + serial reconciliation; no reflash. We'll attach a signed QA checklist for each reworked unit.
kyle_finance: Quick on invoices — we'll need one consolidated invoice plus a credit note for the air split (so bookkeeping matches committed PO). Frank, can you confirm invoice SKU mapping and provide a credit note reference?
frank_vendor: Will issue: INV-RED-2048 for bulk, INV-RED-2048-AIR for air, and CN-RED-2048-EXP for the expedited credit. I'll attach scanned docs by EOD.
jamie_sourcing: Good. Two operational asks: 1) Alice — book Thu 14:00-18:00 as primary intake for flagged air units; 2) Frank — send manifest CSV sample and label S3 link. Also we need customs HS code confirmation — vendor please confirm HS for GPUs so brokerage can preclear.
frank_vendor: HS:8471.70.90 confirmed. Manifest CSV sample (first lines):
```
sku,serial,qty,po,carrier,awb
H100-48GB,ABC12345,1,PO-7822,Air,123-4567890
H100-48GB,DEF67890,1,PO-7822,Air,123-4567890
H100-48GB,GHI23456,1,PO-7822,Sea,987-6543210
```
alice_ops: Receiving checklist: need RMA header with: RMA#, original PO, vendor contact, QA checkbox, hold reason (serial mismatch), and a designated bin for quarantined units. Depot email: depot-ops@redwood.test. I'll /book-dock Thu 2025-07-17 14:00-18:00 now.
ops-bot: Command accepted: /book-dock Thu 2025-07-17 14:00-18:00 slotID=SLT-442. Please attach expected pallet count.
maria_pm: Also callout for product: label any reworked units with a small yellow sticker + internal rework note for traceability. We'll add to the rollout risk register.
frank_vendor: Uploaded labels and manifest to s3://redwood-shipments/PO-7822/labels_and_manifest.csv and sent to depot-ops@redwood.test. RMA numbers: RMA-9001..RMA-9012 for flagged 12 units.
alice_ops: Got the s3 link. Pallet count for air boxes = 3 pallets, sea bulk = 9 pallets. Depot prep complete. We'll quarantine flagged units until CN posts and QA verifies.
kyle_finance: Once CN posted, finance will net the expedited charge and process vendor payment. Please cc finance on the CN email.
frank_vendor: Will cc kyle_finance and jamie_sourcing. ETA for CN: within 24h.
jamie_sourcing: Thanks all — plan looks solid. Follow-ups: frank to send CN, frank to confirm carrier pickup window for air leg, alice to confirm intake after dock booking, kyle to confirm netting process. If anything slips, we pivot to full sea and hold SLAs. :thumbsup:
alice_ops: I'll post a short intake SOP in #eng-ops after processing the units so on-call knows the quarantine flow.
frank_vendor: Carrier pickup for air scheduled 2025-07-16 18:00 local. Will update if changes.
ops-bot: Note: this thread linked to ticket INF-GPU-3142.
